note: Treg: regulatory T cells — distinct cluster at the lower-right (CD25+, CD127 low/negative), well separated from the broader CD25-mid CD127-high conventional CD4 cloud. The classical Treg signature.
tips: Canonical Treg identification within CD4+ helper T cells. Treg: CD25hi CD127lo (CD25/IL-2Rα is highly expressed on Treg, and CD127/IL-7Rα is down-regulated, together distinguishing Treg from activated conventional CD4 cells which can transiently up-regulate CD25 but retain CD127). Useful co-markers: Foxp3 is the canonical intracellular Treg transcription factor and gold-standard marker but requires fixation/permeabilization — not included in this surface-only panel. The CD25hiCD127lo surface signature is well-validated as a Foxp3+ Treg proxy.
